summary: Renders the toast queue and supplies the `useToast` hook. Mount once, near the app root.
useWhen: the app shows toasts anywhere — this is the only way to get `useToast`

useInstead.when: you only need one persistent in-page message
useInstead.why: no provider, no queue, and it stays put

top-left.use: rare — for RTL layouts or where the top-right is occupied

top-right.use: the common desktop choice, out of the way of primary content

bottom-left.use: keeps toasts clear of a right-hand panel

bottom-right.use: close to where a save or submit action usually sits

children.note: your app — the provider wraps it

guarantees: the live region is the container, declared once and always present — a region that appears at the same moment as its content is not reliably announced
`limit` drops the oldest toasts, so the stack can never cover the page
requires: mounting exactly one ToastProvider — a second live region competes with the first

antiPatterns.dont: mounting a ToastProvider per route or per page
antiPatterns.why: toasts queued before the switch are unmounted mid-announcement, and two live regions announce over each other
the toasts are removed from the tree when the modal closes, and hidden from assistive tech while it is open
an unbounded stack covers the content the toasts are about
